title: Fourth norm as a normalized sum
statement: Let $\\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set and let $f:\\Omega\\to\\mathbb R$. Its uniform $L^4$ norm equals $\\bigl(\\sum_{x\\in\\Omega}|f(x)|^4\\bigr)^{1/4}/|\\Omega|^{1/4}$.
